claim.statement: Network partitions cannot split the brain because Raft needs a majority; minority-side nodes keep running apps but cannot deploy, and during a sustained partition certificate rotation fails at 30 minutes and workload certificates expire at 1 hour (4 hours with the grace period).

sources.quote: Network partitions can't cause split-brain: Raft requires a majority quorum
certificate rotation fails (at 30 minutes), and workload certificates expire (at 1 hour, or 4 hours with the grace period)

claim.measurable: Partition one of three nodes with nftables or relish fault; the majority keeps serving writes, the minority refuses them; existing connections and apps keep working; verify the progressive degradation timeline (stale service map for new cross-partition connections immediately, cert rotation failing at 30 min, workload cert expiry at 1 h or 4 h). After heal the council converges. relish test --chaos scenario minority_partition_degrades_and_heals covers the council case.
